review: Direct upgrade from Base Ryoshu and even more so. She is incredibly good at clashing at Uptie 4, and works extremely well in all content. Her S3 inflicts a lot of Slash Fragility, so she is essential to setting up nukes on teams where most of the damage is slash. Notable E.G.O Synergies: 4th Match Flame - While Seven Ryoshu can not fuel this E.G.O. while in the proper team, it can enhance damage and clash of this ID
